output.name: Skerá

anatomy.part: left shoulder where neck meets the left wing
left wingtip (brightest star of the patch)

output.myth: Ennu made the hawk the winter the gulls stole three nets of Halla's cod and laughed at her. He cut it from red sailcloth and gave it a bone beak and two wings of cloth that never flapped. A hawk, Ennu said, is only a shadow with patience. He flew it over the nets, and the gulls, who never read the sky, went screaming off the cliffs. Then Tavo the Gale came to see what was up there and pulled hard at the string, and Ennu had to hold on with both hands. The hawk did not fall. It hangs at the top of the Windward Reach with its wings out, not moving, because Hesk keeps the string wound and will not let the Gale have it. When the nets are wet and the gulls come back, you can see its shadow on the water. Ennu is still holding on, and his hands are never cold.
